## Week 4-6

Good morning everyone! I trust you had a relaxing long weekend! I was able to meet my twin grandkiddos, Oliver and Bazil, over the weekend, so that was something for me to be grateful for. They are both home after a couple months in the NICU, which was a long slog for my daughter and her husband. 

To recap the last couple of weeks, thank you for your participation on October 2 in our tour of the Pacific School for Innovation and Inquiry (and a S/O to Monta for hosting me on Zoom.) Please make sure that the visit shows up in your blog reflections as we progress through the course.

Also, thank you for your attentiveness and questions during Jesse Miller's presentation last week (Oct 9.) Jesse normally teaches EDCI 338, and if you liked his presentation, that can be a good course if you have room for it in your program. Again, make sure your key take-aways show up in your weekly reflections on your blog.
